indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX event_rejoin_requests_pkey ON public.event_rejoin_requests USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rejoin_requests_one_pending_idx ON public.event_rejoin_requests USING btree (participation_id) WHERE (status = 'pending'::text)
CREATE INDEX rejoin_requests_participation_date_idx ON public.event_rejoin_requests USING btree (participation_id, requested_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX rejoin_requests_reviewer_idx ON public.event_rejoin_requests USING btree (reviewed_by) WHERE (reviewed_by IS NOT NULL)
